en: • Introducing a special set of 00 Gundam that you can enjoy from combination to display.
• Set items of 1/100 00 Gundam, 1/100 O Raiser, Action Base 1 Celestial Being Ver.
• The GN drives on both shoulders are equipped with a light emitting gimmick using a light unit.
• Reproduce the combination gimmick of 00 Gundam and O Raiser
• The included action base has a special color.
